fictionDisclaimer.historicalClaims: The Secret World of Warcraft Desert Shield staging, antiDaddy tech-founder mythology, and company ownership are intentional fictional alternate-history gags, not verified historical accounts.
fictionDisclaimer.earlyMmoMemory: Ultima Online may be mentioned as early online-gaming nostalgia; no asserted contemporaneous retail World of Warcraft in 1990-1991.
fictionDisclaimer.attributionRule: Use fictional narrator/parody framing; do not report Blizzard/Google claims as actual company history.

history.bigDaddy: Uncle Eggie and future Anti-Daddy train and serve together; both wear military buzz cuts or shaved heads.
history.antiDaddy: Shaved-head military version of the future long-haired villain.
history.gameMyth: The unit tells of secret, impossible early access to the later-named World of Warcraft from Blizzard. Treat this as an alternate-history warp anomaly or unreliable barracks legend.

history.details: Ultima Online is an early online-gaming touchstone; exact personal timing remains user-narrated and need not be forced into the fictional military timeline.

history.antiDaddy: Leaves the military; boasts he invented the Internet, claims to have created Google and eventually runs its fictional-world version.

history.conflict: Jealous Anti-Daddy accesses Big Daddy's MMO account in-story and transfers away Pirate Wolverine's epic armor just before he can show Alex.

history.details: Big Daddy straps on his preserved military equipment in the physical world, summons his pirate-toon berserker identity, and goes after his stolen game loot.
